rationale: All runs are setup-limited at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC; hold (+0.05-0.11 ns), slew/cap (<=19 vs bar 295) and DRC never bind. Round 1's ocs-like recipe at 8.59 ns gave 7.61/7.76: with ~1 ns slack the resizer idles (same 277 repair buffers as ocs), so T_eff is the natural path and this recipe has plateaued near 7.55. blabla and y_huff scored poorly because port paths (IO delay grows with their loose ~18 ns targets) set worst slack; their reg-to-reg paths were 6.62 and 7.49 ns, the best seen. Both use AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing and non-timing-driven routability placement; blabla adds orfs RC and util 27. Replicate that at the tightest target; TPE explores density, repair margins, post-GRT options.
